ulm_full.staging: The board as the campaign opens: Mack in Swabia, six French corps in the four provinces round him. Ney attacks.
ulm_full.shows: a great battle won: 3 corps march to the guns, Soult awaits orders, the Emperor in person, the enemy's line broken

the_capitulation.staging: The board as the campaign opens: Mack in Swabia, six French corps in the four provinces round him. Ney attacks.
the_capitulation.shows: Mack is taken on the field.

last_hour.staging: The board as the campaign opens: Mack in Swabia, six French corps in the four provinces round him. Ney attacks.
last_hour.shows: Murat comes up at the last hour (56 against a bar of 55)

the_flank.staging: Two attacks on Swabia in one turn: Lannes goes in first from Franche-Comte, then Ney from the Rhineland: the second comes in on a flank.
the_flank.shows: The attack comes in from 2 provinces (Franche-Comte, Rhineland): +1 on the dice.

ordinary_brief.staging: Lannes alone against the Archduke John in the Tyrol; nobody near.
ordinary_brief.shows: an ordinary exchange (defender_tactical_victory): the brief form

defeat_defending.staging: The enemy's turn: Mack falls on Bernadotte in Franconia, the Archduke John in the Tyrol beside it.
defeat_defending.shows: a defeat on the defence: the player's line on the left, beaten

observed_full.staging: Two courts' war in full sight: Kutuzov against Hohenlohe in Silesia.
observed_full.shows: another court's battle, seen in full: the observer's register

the_day_hangs.staging: Davout against the Archduke John in the mountains, nobody near.
the_day_hangs.shows: neither line gives way: the day hangs

the_guns.staging: Marmont's guns, commissioned and ordered to support Ney, fire first.
the_guns.shows: a supporting battery fires before the assault

enemy_comes.staging: Davout, from Munich, attacks Kutuzov in the Tyrol; Buxhowden stands in Bohemia beside the field, ordered to support Kutuzov: the enemy's corps comes up unseen. (An Austrian corps cannot be staged for this: the court's doctrine holds the Archduke John's best march, 67, under his bar of 70 — the Hofkriegsrat's slowness is the game's, not the tool's.)
enemy_comes.shows: Buxhowden comes up unseen and is turned up on arrival

four_a_side.staging: Ulm with the whole Austrian army in Swabia: the Archdukes John and Charles beside Mack, and Schwarzenberg and Hiller commissioned from the pool. Four corps a side on the table, the French reserve behind: the deepest line the table seats.
four_a_side.shows: four corps a side on the table, 2 and 0 more in reserve (attacker_tactical_victory)
